patch.value: Bisect stable changes using a linked pm test command
Add pm vcs bisect driven by pm test <id> --run, persisting change-id results across history rewrites and restoring the original working state.

Good/bad boundaries identify the first failing stable change using the linked real pm test; rewritten commit ids reuse change results; interrupted/failed tests and conflicted candidates have explicit outcomes; TOON and JSON report the result and original state is restored.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Plan for bisect: single command 'pm vcs bisect' with start|good|bad|skip|run|status|reset subcommands. Durable session state lives in the worktree's private control directory (atomic write) so a crash mid-walk leaves a resumable session; session milestones (start, conclusion, reset) are appended to PM history as comments on the linked item, so concurrent agents see each other's sessions and append-only history is never clobbered. Candidates are ordered oldest-first by ancestry; outcomes are keyed by stable change identity so rewritten commit ids (rebase/amend/describe) reuse recorded results. Linked test execution reuses the pm SDK runTest (pm test --run semantics). Outcomes: good, bad, skip (manual), untestable (spawn/timeout/signal/empty), conflicted (candidate carries unresolved conflict units). Original branch and commit are restored after success, refusal, SIGINT and crash-resume.
